analysis.title: Meta Platforms Inc. (META): Q3 '26 Earnings First Take
key_insights: Meta Q3 '26 total revenue was $64.60bn, +26% YoY, above GSe $63.70bn, Visible Alpha Street $63.47bn and above the high end of the $61.0-64.0bn guide. GS expects an initial positive investor reaction.
Advertising revenue was $63.06bn, +26% YoY (+26% FXN), vs GSe +23.7% YoY. By region: US & Canada $28.44bn, Europe $14.23bn, Asia $11.53bn, Rest of World $8.86bn.

Q3 GAAP operating income was $12.99bn (20% margin) vs GSe $19.38bn and Street $17.67bn. A ~$9.9bn one-time accrual for an agreement with a group of US State Attorneys General, resolving teen mental health and social media litigation, drove the miss. GS says profitability exceeded GSe and Street estimates excluding this charge.
Q3 GAAP EPS was $3.83 vs GSe $6.49 and Street $5.77, again reflecting the ~$9.9bn accrual.

Segment results: Family of Apps revenue $64.16bn (+26% YoY), operating income $17.12bn (27% margin). Reality Labs revenue $443mm (down 6% YoY), operating loss $(4.13)bn. Daily active people were 3.64bn.
Q4 '26 revenue guide is $73.0-76.0bn vs GSe $74.59bn and Street $73.60bn, with FX a ~100bps headwind to YoY growth.
FY2026 total GAAP expense guide was raised to $175.0-179.0bn vs GSe $168.47bn, Street $169.29bn and prior guide $165-169bn.
FY2026 capex guide is $135.0-145.0bn vs GSe $142.94bn, Street $139.74bn and prior guide $130-145bn. Management framed continued elevated investment beyond 2026 without quantifying it.
Full-time employees fell ~12% QoQ and ~15% YoY. Management also framed a YoY reduction in Reality Labs losses in 2026 and initial guidance for further reduction in 2027.

Expected call focus: early reads on Muse, the market opportunity for AI applied to SMBs and large enterprises, durability of core ad revenue strength, triangulating qualitative 2027 investment comments, and a new class of non-voting stock and what it implies for capital raising.

GS reiterates Buy with a $860 12-month price target (stock $694.25 as of 20 Oct close, 23.9% upside). The target blends EV/GAAP EBIT on NTM+1 year estimates with a modified DCF using EV/FCF-SBC on NTM+4 year estimates discounted back 3 years.

market_movers.rationale: Revenue beat above the high end of guidance with ads +26% YoY. Profit miss reflects a one-time ~$9.9bn legal accrual, and GS sees profitability above estimates excluding it.

earnings_insights: META Q3 '26 reported 10/21: total revenue $64.60bn vs GSe $63.70bn, Visible Alpha Street $63.47bn, guide $61.0-64.0bn.
META Q3 '26 reported GAAP EPS $3.83 (includes ~$9.9bn one-time legal accrual) vs GSe $6.49 and Street $5.77 estimates.
META Q3 '26 reported GAAP operating income $12.99bn (20% margin) vs GSe $19.38bn and Street $17.67bn estimates.
META Q4 '26 revenue guidance $73.0-76.0bn vs GSe $74.59bn and Street $73.60bn estimates.

META FY2026 GAAP expense guidance $175.0-179.0bn (prior $165-169bn) vs GSe $168.47bn and Street $169.29bn. FY2026 capex guidance $135.0-145.0bn (prior $130-145bn) vs GSe $142.94bn and Street $139.74bn.
GS forecasts for META (GSe): FY26E EPS $31.67, FY27E $32.26, FY28E $37.48; FY26E revenue $255.4bn, FY27E $312.6bn.
risk_factors: Competition for user growth, engagement and ad dollars.
Large investments in long-tailed initiatives depress margins for longer than GSe expects.
No or low levels of incremental shareholder returns.
Inability to monetize upside optionality opportunities.
